details:
Hello. We've been making UDON Worlds for a while and been utilizing available keys, buttons, axes and the like for a lot of worlds now. Especially using the thumbsticks.
In Desktop, key bindings shouldn't be a problem since we have the entire keyboard at our disposal. But for some VR Users and for some worlds, the thumbstick button is quite essential. As well as the rest of the buttons.
Gamepads are out of the question. I mean, we can utilize gamepads, but I wish and ask if it's possible to bind LB and RB (L1, R1) on the gamepads.
Going back to the topic at hand, I'm not saying that the Avatar 3.0 proved to have worsen the features. I mean it's good, really good. But all I'm trying to ask is, is it possible to have that feature for a VRCStation? I mean, it's only a VRCStation, which it can be an option over there to enable or disable the 3.0 Menu while in use, like a checkbox in the unity editor.
I'm not asking to like drop 3.0 of course. All I'm asking is if it's possible to have something like that as a feature on VRCStations to take advantage over the controller bindings. Although I understand, as a world creator, I will have to find another way to make controls work especially for vehicles.
I apologize if this might be a problem for some developers. Then again, this is just a question, and pretty much a suggestion.
title: VRCStation - An option to disable 3.0 Menu.. If Possible
